subject: Found the temple!
body:
Three Stones!! You're actually doing this, mate.

I think I've found where the Soul Stone is kept. There's a temple hanging off the roof of the Underside, right on the tip of an upside-down mountain over the dream dunes. Craig is dropping a map off now. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:survey_soul_temple

Somebody lives up there. Well. Sort of lives. He knows how the Stone works and he'll tell you, but I don't think it's going to be anything nice. Be polite to him.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
